body:
**Recursive-interface research construction and scoped negative result; no new kappa.**

Carrying partial source sums in one dirty binary connector avoids repeated restoration between output stars. This package proves a universal four-source construction for arbitrarily many outputs and identifies the first obstruction: all 945 canonical five-source paths using each source twice cover at most 31 of 32 possible readout differences. An explicit twelve-toggle path covers all 32. For the batch containing all 31 nonzero five-source output patterns, the complete optimum is **74 queries** in the stated straight-line alphabet; the 72-query support bound is unattainable and parity excludes 73.

Two literal repairs and their full recursive lowerings are supplied. The varying-factor fixture uses **182 primitive calls versus 278 for separate column stars**, with the same **four borrowed dirty rows**. The proof prices source/coefficient access, every child and inverse, scratch, frames, preparation, dispatch and tape work. This is an abstract query-model result, not selected-supplier integration, a measured speedup or a general circuit lower bound.

Only `research/universal-connector-boundary/` is added. Its README, exact certificate, source pins, claim, validation and attribution form the review package. Discovery base: `91a2094f2e022930069e8cfdc810a3ea1b81cd09`; refreshed submission base: `47481c89fd30a43f8f882eb4b391e89c29273fd0`. Main's new PR890 selection at conditional κ = 0.001661957774647029 was followed to its construction/review and remains unchanged.

OS assignment seed **52**, recursive-interface track. PR934 is the direct binary-query predecessor, pinned at `f3100aec6ce6a7b061987875d5e9a8b93801ac0b`, with original README/NOTICE retained. Credit also goes to PR889's fanout interface and Chafik Boukhalfa's PR628 dirty commutator. Concurrent PR938 counts one-source equality cases; this adds a multi-source universal-path criterion and exact failure boundary. The full queue refresh reached #939 and the immediate check included #940/#941. No pinned coordination issue existed, so the claim and result link are local. Prepared by **Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**, under Apache-2.0.

Validation on macOS / CPython 3.14.6:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/universal-connector-boundary/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/universal-connector-boundary/test_package.py
```

Expected: `PASS_UNIVERSAL_CONNECTOR_BOUNDARY pairings=945 max_coverage=31 queries=74 leaves=182` and `PASS_UNIVERSAL_CONNECTOR_PACKAGE relocation=1 regeneration=2 corruptions=6`.

- Restricted-growth generation and independent endpoint matchings agree on every canonical coverage record: 105 four-source and 945 five-source paths.
- Free noncommutative replay verifies root words, literal children, arbitrary dirty scratch, factor order and inverses. Independent dense replay adds 789 forward and 789 inverse cases.
- Eleven obligation-specific controls and six on-disk corruptions reject. Normal/optimized runs, standalone relocation and exact certificate/evidence regeneration pass.
- Exact predecessor Git blobs and both base-context pins match. `make selected-record-check`, all five existing selected-result tests and staged whitespace checks pass on the final commit. The checkout is clean.

No full repository regeneration, selected cold replay, hosted-CI result, proof-assistant theorem or independent human-review pass is claimed. Physical supplier realization, common labels/frames/owners, whole-row charging, all-size compilation, tape/precision and outer analytic obligations remain open.
title: Research: sharp four/five-source dirty-connector boundary (no new kappa)
